# Parts diagrams

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

[Partial] Connect the Diode Dynamics C1R Hitch Light Kit harness pins 1 through 7 to corresponding factory wires. [t273]

[Partial] Identify the auxiliary transmission cooler and soak it in fluid to help identify connections. [t78]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. Cut the male and female ends off the new harness.
2. [Partial] Strip the wires from both cut ends of the new harness.
3. [Partial] Locate pin 1 on your vehicle's factory harness connector.
4. Connect a white wire to the yellow Nissan wire at pin 1.
5. [Partial] Locate pin 2 on your vehicle's factory harness connector.
6. Connect a black wire to the white Nissan wire at pin 2.
7. Locate pin 3 on your vehicle's factory harness connector and attach a brown patch there.
8. [Partial] Locate pin 4 on your vehicle's factory harness connector.
9. Connect a yellow wire to the green Nissan wire at pin 4.
10. [Partial] Locate pin 5 on your vehicle's factory harness connector.
11. Connect a green wire to the blue Nissan wire at pin 5.
12. [Partial] Locate pin 6 on your vehicle's factory harness connector.
13. Connect a blue wire to the brown Nissan wire at pin 6.
14. [Partial] Locate pin 7 on your vehicle's factory harness connector.
15. Connect a red wire to the black Nissan wire at pin 7.
16. [Partial] Plug the modified DD harness into the vehicle's main connector.

_Procedure reported by [t273]. Photos of this job are in the source: <https://www.xterranation.org/index.php?threads/how-to-install-and-wire-diode-dynamics-c1r-hitch-light.10877/>_

<details><summary>Alternate procedure [t78] [Partial]</summary>

## Tips & gotchas

- Use this view to compare your specific harness against the standard layout if yours differs. [t273]
- Verify the specific wire colors on your harness before starting, as factory variations exist. [t273]
- [Partial] Note that this wiring scheme is for a kit with six wires (running, brake, reverse) rather than four. [t273]
- Align this view with your vehicle's wire colors to ensure correct matching. [t273]
- [Partial] Soak in fluid to help identify where lines connect on the smaller unit if needed. [t78]
